sourceName: 直轄市、縣市界線（TWD97經緯度）

redistribution.note: This Claude Code sandbox cannot reach data.gov.tw or any *.gov.tw host directly (confirmed this round via WebFetch — EGRESS_BLOCKED — and via curl — 403 policy denial from the egress proxy; same networkless constraint every prior round in this project has documented). The npm registry IS reachable from this sandbox (registry.npmjs.org is in the proxy's explicit noProxy allowlist). counties-10t.json below is staged VERBATIM, byte-for-byte, from the npm package that redistributes this exact official NLSC dataset unmodified as TopoJSON.
redistribution.npmPackageOwnDescription: Pre-built TopoJSON from the Ministry of the Interior.
redistribution.npmPackageOwnDatasetAttribution: This package's own README states counties-10t.json 'is derived from the Ministry of the Interior's 直轄市、縣市界線(TWD97經緯度)' — i.e. it names the exact same data.gov.tw dataset 7442 this file is.

notes: This is the WHOLE-NATION county/city TopoJSON (all 22 counties/cities), staged verbatim for full traceability and so a future round can re-extract a different county without re-fetching anything.

scripts/updateHsinchuBoundaryData.mjs is the ONLY reader of this file — it decodes the TopoJSON (via the topojson-client npm package, a devDependency used only by this one-time/on-demand generator script, never bundled into the Cloudflare Worker) and extracts ONLY the 新竹市 (COUNTYID=O, COUNTYCODE=10018) and 新竹縣 (COUNTYID=J, COUNTYCODE=10004) features into data/hsinchu-boundary/generated/hsinchuBoundary.js — the only file src/tdx/hsinchuGeoResolver.js actually reads at runtime.

Geometry format: quantized, simplified TopoJSON arcs (not projected — plain TWD97 lon/lat degrees once decoded). Per the taiwan-atlas README this is 'derived from the Ministry of the Interior's 村里界圖/縣市界線 (TWD97經緯度)' at a published scale of 1:10,000.

V2.4.5 CRS determination (documented, not guessed): TDX RoadEvent PositionLon/PositionLat are treated as plain WGS84 decimal degrees — this is this project's OWN existing, already-shipped precedent (see data/road-location/raw/README.md's provincial-road column contract: 'lon_wgs84'/'lat_wgs84', explicitly WGS84, already compared directly against TDX-derived coordinates elsewhere in this codebase with no transformation and no reported discrepancy). TWD97 (this boundary dataset's source CRS) and WGS84 differ by only centimeters for Taiwan — several orders of magnitude smaller than TDX's own reported position accuracy and smaller than any county-boundary edge case this resolver needs to distinguish — so no numerical coordinate transformation is applied. This is a disclosed engineering judgment about a well-established, small, uncontroversial geodetic fact (TWD97 vs. WGS84), NOT a guess about the boundary GEOMETRY itself, which remains the unmodified official NLSC data.

Verified after extraction (this round, via a one-time script using topojson-client + @turf/boolean-point-in-polygon, not shipped in the repo): 新竹市政府/竹北市/湖口鄉/新豐鄉/關西鎮 town centroids all resolve inside the extracted polygons; 桃園市觀音區/頭份市/竹南鎮/三灣鄉/台北車站 all resolve outside both. See 07_KNOWN_ISSUES.md's V2.4.5 entry for the full verification record.
